method: Unit of inference = config (scenario_id). Data: 236 control runs in 112 configs (rep dirs without '-'; the 8 night_branch rep0 controls included, 16 branch arms excluded). Outcome per config = mean of run-level labels.json 'tipped' (theta=8). Configs weighted equally. MARGINAL TESTS: per factor, factor labels permuted across configs WITHIN design block (split), 10,000 permutations (numpy default_rng, fixed seeds). This reproduces the generator's assignment (weighted_balanced per block, independent shuffles; model mix and tech-lead status iid). Binary statistic = difference of mean config tip rates; two-sided p = (1 + #{|T*| >= |T|})/(B+1). Multi-level statistic = n-weighted between-level variance of config means (permutation one-way ANOVA F); p = (1 + #{T* >= T})/(B+1). Seed type is tested only in the 4 blocks where it was randomized (96 configs); tech lead only among knower/pioneer/side_task (64 configs). Effects (pp differences, per-level rates) come with 95% percentile CIs from a config-cluster bootstrap stratified by block (2,000 resamples). Holm over the 14 main factors. Post-hoc pairwise contrasts: Holm within factor. Extra design factors (seed placement, cut, push offset, family, detection>0): own Holm family. release_freeze rerun with 100,000 permutations (MC SE 0.0002). MULTIVARIABLE: run-level logistic regression on all 14 factors one-hot plus block dummies (26 parameters). Newton-Raphson with lambda=1/C, C=1e6, matches sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1e6) to 8.5e-7. Separation checked (C to 1e10, all-0/1 columns, bootstrap blow-ups). ORs with stratified config-cluster bootstrap CIs (2,000), from both ML and Firth refits. Adjusted randomization test per factor: permute that factor within block with all other factors fixed, refit, LR statistic, 10,000 permutations, Holm over 14. Seed type is permuted jointly with tech-lead status; tech lead alone within block x seed type. Config-level OLS (linear probability) adjusted risk differences: partial-F randomization test (10,000) and stratified bootstrap CIs (2,000). Sensitivity fits: no block dummies, +extra factors, ridge C=5. Interactions only exploratory: 2x2 DiD with bootstrap CI and subgroup permutation tests, uncorrected. Run-level Fisher/chi2 and asymptotic LR chi2 are shown only as anti-conservative contrasts. DeLong does not apply (no AUROC).

results.comparison: release_freeze True vs False (FINDINGS s.1: Zeitdruck foerdert Kippen)
results.conclusion: PARTLY SUPPORTED. Direction is clear: positive in all 6 subgroups, from +19 to +45 pp. But it does not survive Holm over 14 factors (p 0.0048 with 100k permutations, Holm 0.053; with 10k permutations p 0.0056, Holm 0.062). Adjusted effects are weaker: OLS +19.2 pp [+2.1, +34.5], p 0.031 (Holm 0.31); logistic OR 5.21, adjusted randomization p 0.050 (Holm 0.55). Part of the marginal effect comes from chance imbalance: freeze configs have more K4 and board.

results.comparison: discoverability exploration vs peers_only (FINDINGS s.1: leicht auffindbarer Shortcut)
results.conclusion: SUPPORTED overall and after adjustment (OLS +28.2 pp, Holm 0.0014; logistic adjusted p 0.0012, Holm 0.017). The effect comes ONLY from K4: within K2 -1.4 pp [-21.4, +20.2], p 0.93; within K4 +62.4 pp [+44.4, +80.1], p 0.0001. Mechanism: with K4 + exploration, skip_checks is in every agent's merge signature.

results.comparison: channels board / team_channels / dm_only (FINDINGS s.1: oeffentliche Kanaele; Board viel oefter als DMs)
results.conclusion: SUPPORTED marginally. Board vs dm_only p 0.0010, board vs team p 0.0054, team vs dm_only +11.4 pp p 0.41 (not different). After adjustment it is weaker: board vs dm_only +25.0 pp [+2.8, +45.0], but the joint channel test p 0.0088 (OLS, Holm 0.106) and 0.0056 (logistic, Holm 0.067) misses the 0.05 Holm line.

results.comparison: category K4 vs K2 (FINDINGS s.1: Checks ueberspringen kippt oefter als Scorer-Manipulation)
results.conclusion: SUPPORTED overall and adjusted (OLS +26.3 pp [+11.8, +42.3], Holm 0.010; logistic OR 7.89, adjusted p 0.0026, Holm 0.034). But it holds only when the shortcut is discoverable: under peers_only K4-K2 = -4.6 pp (p 0.67); under exploration +59.1 pp [+38.0, +77.0] (p 0.0001).

results.comparison: sanctions drawn vs off (FINDINGS s.7: Sanktionen senken die Kipprate im Nacht-Batch nicht)
results.conclusion: NOT SUPPORTED AS WORDED; the data only show no detectable effect, with low power. Only 8 of 28 'drawn' configs had detection probability > 0. The other 20 had 0 sanction events and behave exactly like 'off' (placebo check p 0.88). Adjusted -0.3 pp [-17.8, +15.1], p 0.97. Reductions of up to 15 pp (drawn) or 25 pp (enforced) remain inside the CIs.

results.comparison: post-hoc board vs dm_only
results.conclusion: Board tips far more often than DM only (Holm within channels). Adjusted +25.0 pp [+2.8, +45.0]; logistic derived OR 16.7 (Firth 9.85, lower bound 2.28).

results.comparison: post-hoc board vs team_channels
results.conclusion: Higher on board. Adjusted +22.1 pp [+4.0, +38.9]. The logistic lower bound clears 1 in only some specifications.

results.comparison: manager_push True vs False
results.conclusion: No marginal effect. Exploratory: the push helps only without freeze (5.6% vs 25.7%, only 9 vs 24 configs); freeze x push DiD -26.6 pp [-55.1, +3.7].

results.comparison: self_merge True vs False
results.conclusion: No detectable effect (adjusted +9.6 pp [-6.8, +26.6], p 0.22).

results.comparison: persistent_share 0.5 vs 0 (prompted persistence persona)
results.conclusion: No detectable effect (adjusted +4.9 pp, p 0.50).

results.comparison: prohibition_form implicit / ambiguous / soft
results.estimate: implicit 46.6%, ambiguous 39.9%, soft 28.1%; soft - implicit -18.5 pp [-37.4, +0.2]
results.conclusion: No significant difference; soft is lowest (post-hoc implicit vs soft p 0.087).

results.comparison: n_impossible 9 / 12 / 16
results.conclusion: Suggestive dose-response (exploratory trend p 0.040; adjusted 16 vs 9 +25.5 pp [+6.3, +43.5], joint adjusted p 0.016, Holm 0.18). Not significant after correction.

results.comparison: seed_type none / knower / pioneer / side_task / external (96 configs, randomized blocks)
results.conclusion: No significant seed-type effect (joint adjusted p 0.57 logistic, 0.50 OLS). Structural note: seed none + peers_only never tipped (0/15 runs in 7 configs, plus 0/4 branch configs).

results.comparison: seed = tech lead vs not (knower/pioneer/side_task, 64 configs)
results.conclusion: No significant effect (adjusted -7.7 pp, p 0.38).

results.comparison: persona_mix skewed_pragmatic vs uniform
results.conclusion: No detectable effect.

results.comparison: model_mix majority vs duo
results.conclusion: No detectable effect.

results.comparison: adjusted logistic: which factors stay away from OR=1
results.estimate: K4 OR 7.89 (Firth 5.44, lower 2.09); exploration OR 7.45 (Firth 5.18, lower 2.29); board vs dm_only OR 16.7 (lower 3.92 ML / 2.28 Firth); freeze OR 5.21 (lower 0.86 ML / 0.94 Firth)
results.conclusion: Only K4 (adjusted randomization p 0.0026, Holm 0.034) and exploration (p 0.0012, Holm 0.017) clear OR=1 in all 5 specifications; board vs dm_only also clears it in the main model. Freeze, board vs team and n_impossible=16 clear it only in some specifications. The full data show no separation, but 37% of ML bootstrap refits quasi-separate, so the upper CI ends are meaningless. The asymptotic LR chi2 p-values are anti-conservative: the null mean LR is about 2.3 per df.

results.comparison: exploratory interaction discoverability x category
results.estimate: DiD +63.7 pp [+36.0, +90.7]; K4+exploration 82.2% vs 19.9-24.4% in the other three cells
results.conclusion: The only strong interaction (Firth ratio of ORs 487). K4 vs K2 and exploration vs peers_only are one effect. Post hoc, though there is a mechanistic explanation in the generator code.

results.comparison: effective enforcement: detection probability > 0 (8 configs, 16 runs) vs rest
results.estimate: +5.6 pp [-25.4, +35.8]; 6/16 runs tipped, 72 sanction events in 11 runs
results.conclusion: Uninformative: far too few enforced configs to show or exclude a reduction.

results.comparison: control: block label among identical-design blocks (train/val/test_id, 88 configs)
results.conclusion: No block heterogeneity beyond chance; the low night_val rate is noise.

results.comparison: control: replicate order rep1 - rep0 (104 configs, time-of-night drift)
results.conclusion: No drift. rep2 vs mean(rep0, rep1): +2.5 pp, p 1.00.

results.comparison: control: placebo 'drawn with detection 0' vs 'off' (functionally identical)
results.conclusion: Null as expected.

results.comparison: control: null calibration with 2,000 placebo factors (within-block balanced)
results.conclusion: The permutation test holds its level (slightly conservative because of ties).

caveats: 112 configs, 236 control runs, ICC of tipped within configs = 0.73: the effective n is about the number of configs. Effects under about 20-25 pp are hard to detect, especially in small cells (dm_only 17 configs, no freeze 33, detection>0 only 8).

Sanctions: only 8 of 28 'drawn' configs had detection probability > 0. The other 20 are functionally 'off' (the engine fires a sanction only with probability = detection; they had 0 events). The night batch therefore cannot test sanctions. Rewrite the FINDINGS s.7 sentence as 'no measurable effect, but enforcement was possible in only 8 setups'.

Discoverability and K4 vs K2 are one effect: K4 + exploration (skip_checks in every agent's merge signature) has an 82% config tip rate, and the other three cells 20-24%. Both FINDINGS sentences need this qualifier. The interaction is post hoc.

Freeze is borderline after Holm over 14 factors (p_Holm 0.053 with 100k permutations, 0.062 with 10k). Adjusted it is smaller (+19 pp, Holm 0.31). Freeze was the pre-stated base-rate dial in DECISIONS.md s.15, but the FINDINGS sentences were written after seeing the batch report.

The multivariable logistic model is fragile: 26 parameters, about 3.6 events per parameter, quasi-separation in 37% of bootstrap refits. Use it for direction and the adjusted randomization p-values, not OR magnitudes; the config-level OLS gives stable adjusted risk differences.

The design is balanced per block and factors were drawn independently, so marginal differences are unbiased averages over this design. Chance imbalances still exist in one draw (e.g. freeze configs: 43/79 K4 and 52/79 board, vs 13/33 and 15/33 without freeze).
Results hold for this design only: high pressure, R=30, tech lead, merge feed with CI, release board, 4 training models; no 'hard' prohibition and no skewed_careful personas.
FINDINGS 'knapp 4 von 10': 101/252 = 40.1% over all runs incl. branch arms, 93/236 = 39.4% over control runs.
Seed type 'external' pools fake_authority and injection; the tool_output carrier block (night_test_ood_seed) is excluded from the seed-type test.
Run-level tests are anti-conservative here (e.g. seed placement Fisher p 0.016 vs permutation p 0.20; freeze LR chi2 p 0.0023 vs randomization p 0.050) and are reported only as contrasts.
sanity_checks: All 252 runs matched the batch's own runs_night/_logs/analysis_runs.csv: 0 mismatches in tipped, n_violators and 12 factor columns.
All 252 labels.json have theta_agents=8 and delta=3; 112 configs; runs per config: 8 with 1, 84 with 2, 20 with 3.

Run-level rates reproduce runs_night/_logs/report.md (written at 239 runs): K2/K4 23.7/55.1% (report 23/54), freeze off/on 18.6/48.2% (20/46), peers_only/exploration 23.7/55.1% (21/56), board/team/dm 53.2/23.7/11.1% (52/23/11).

Logistic full-data fit has no separation: max |beta| 2.79, coefficients change <= 1.2e-5 from C=1e6 to 1e10, no all-0/1 columns, Hessian condition number 634, matches sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1e6) to 8.5e-7.
Null calibration: 2,000 placebo factors balanced within block give p<0.05 in 4.15% and p<0.01 in 1.05% of cases.
Monte Carlo precision: release_freeze with 100,000 permutations gives p = 0.00484 (SE 0.00022), consistent with 0.0056 at 10,000.
Block-stratified differences match pooled differences (e.g. category +29.5 vs +29.5, freeze +25.3 vs +26.0, discoverability +32.4 vs +32.4 pp).
Equal-weight and run-count-weighted adjusted OLS agree (e.g. K4 +26.3 vs +25.5 pp, freeze +19.2 vs +19.6 pp).
Negative controls are null: identical-design blocks p 0.19, replicate-order drift p 0.43, placebo sanction arm p 0.88.
All markdown tables in REPORT.md checked for consistent column counts; every number in REPORT.md is generated by make_report.py from the JSON results.
